headline: Apple's $250 million Siri settlement opens for claims
summary: Apple is settling claims over its AI-upgraded Siri promises for $250 million. Eligible owners of iPhone 15 Pro, Pro Max, or 16 models can now file a claim, with payouts of up to $95 each.

claims.statement: Apple is paying $250 million to settle claims over its AI-upgraded Siri.

sources.quote: Apple is paying $250 million to settle claims that it failed to deliver an AI-upgraded Siri

claims.statement: Eligible owners of iPhone 15 Pro, Pro Max, and iPhone 16 models can submit a claim.

sources.quote: iPhone 15 Pro, iPhone 15 Pro Max, or any iPhone 16 model
Got an iPhone 15 Pro, Pro Max, or 16?

claims.statement: Eligible claimants can receive up to $95 per iPhone.

sources.quote: Apple may pay out up to $95 for each eligible iPhone purchased

claims.statement: Claims must be submitted by December 21.

sources.quote: You have until December 21 to submit a claim.
